name: Meanwhile in Russia
storyline: You are a scientist in a top-secret scientific complex. Your colleagues are special people with unconventional thinking who can destroy the world without giving others time to do it.
summary:
Meanwhile in Russia, is a work-in-progress singleplayer anti-/sci-fi first-person shooter modification for a parody of Half-Life, that was initially authored with XashXT SDK while using Xash3D engine. However, recently the development continued by porting the game to a new engine called XashNT, which is inspired by, and a spirtual successor of Xash3D engine.

An Intro Demo was released on October 25th, 2018.
